svg.title: Gym CRM architecture
svg.desc: REST clients access the CRM API, which stores accounts, assignments, and training sessions in PostgreSQL. After a database transaction commits, the API publishes trainer-keyed workload events to Kafka. A separate workload service consumes them and updates monthly trainer totals in MongoDB. Transient processing failures are retried; exhausted or business-invalid events go to a dead-letter topic. An optional Config Server supplies configuration to both services.
